end.summary:
Practised storing drinking water in clean, covered containers.
Discussed using a ladle or tap instead of hands and cleaning containers regularly.
Explained that clear water may still contain germs or dissolved substances; dissolving is not melting.
Teach-back was not passed; the idea that covering keeps water completely clean was corrected later by discussing ladle use and possible contamination.
end.parentNote: Pari practised keeping drinking water covered, using a ladle, and avoiding hand contact with stored water. They explained that dust, germs, insects, and mosquito eggs can enter uncovered water, and later added that a ladle helps prevent contamination; the mix-up that covered water is automatically completely clean was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to show how they would safely take water from a covered container and name one reason the container should be cleaned.
